rationale.edition: Every changed path lives under web/src/ — the open-source frontend tree. No file touches an enterprise-owned directory (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) and no enterprise-keyword modules (SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, cipher) appear in the paths. The diff is purely OSS.
rationale.skip: The change is user-facing: it replaces two permanently-expanded advisory cards (ZeroAssertionNotice, TestIdMisconfiguredNotice) with a single toolbar chip (JourneySuggestions) that users click to see suggestions and optionally act on. No skip markers, labels, or opt-out comments were found in trigger_comment.txt or feature_hint.txt. The change touches Vue components and i18n strings — not docs-only, CI-only, or test-data-only.
rationale.e2e: The refactored UI flow — a warning chip in the journey toolbar, its popover panel, the action button that appends an assertion, and the chip's disappearance when suggestions resolve — is interactive and user-facing. An E2E test should verify the chip appears with the correct count when a journey has zero assertions, opens a panel on click, emits the add-assertion action, and vanishes when all suggestions are resolved.
rationale.area: The change lives under web/src/components/synthetics/journey/ and web/src/utils/synthetics/. There is no dedicated Synthetics Playwright test folder visible in the enterprise CI matrix overlay; the closest catch-all group that houses cross-cutting specs is GeneralTests, which the enterprise overlay already extends with cipherKeys, logoManagement, and model-pricing specs.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the playwright_matrix group that corresponds to the GeneralTests folder in playwright-tests/. The enterprise overlay's append section confirms this group exists and is used for specs that don't fit a domain-specific shard like Logs or Traces.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff adds and modifies several Vitest unit spec files under web/src/components/synthetics/journey/ and web/src/utils/synthetics/, but none are Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. Unit tests (Vitest) do not count as existing E2E coverage — no E2E specs in the diff.
